violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §744.1201(1))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on DFPS findings, good judgement was not used when a caregiver exposed the child by compelling and encouraging inappropriate behavior when entering a  storage closet with the child and turning off the lights.

finding_variants.text: Based on DFPS findings, good judgement was not used when a caregiver exposed the child by compelling and encouraging inappropriate behavior when entering a  storage closet with the child and turning off the lights.

It was determined during the investigation that the operation used poor judgement by transporting children in a vehicle that did not have  working air conditioner and the vehicle windows were not able to be opened to allow proper air circulation for approximately 21 miles.

Staff did not demonstrate good judgment when they allowed an 8 year old child to play with other YMCA children. The 8 year old is not enrolled at the YMCA. The 8 year old's parents were not in the gym area where the YMCA staff and children were.
A caregiver pushed a child in a swing from the front which resulted in the child falling out and breaking their arm.
Caregivers did not show good judgment when they carried a child.
A caregiver did not show good judgment or self-control when restrained a child on the floor for 9 minutes. The caregiver's actions were not warranted for the child's behavior.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information compiled throughout the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver's good judgment failed when the caregiver chose not to intervene upon observing another caregiver forcefully grasping and pulling a child's arm.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver did not exercise good judgment by allowing children to play soccer in a limited space while other children were stacking crates nearby.
Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Operation staff posted photo of children on personal social media account.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate self control when she raised her voice and became frustrated while directing a child who had a toileting accident.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined a caregiver did not know which children they were responsible and did not accurately count all children in their combined group, resulting in two children being left outside on the playground.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver pushed a child in a swing from the front which resulted in the child falling out and breaking their arm.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered during the investigation, a caregiver was knowledgeable of a child?s ongoing pain following an incident and did not communicate that information to the person in charge promptly.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver failed to exercise/use appropriate judgement when video footage showed the caregiver chasing children while seated in a rolling chair. The caregiver was also observed using rolling chairs to play with and push the children

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation, evidence gathered through interviews and documentation supported that staff did not use good judgement when recording a misbehavior.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the preponderance of evidence there were sufficient evidence to conclude the caregiver lacked good judgement.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The caregiver did not show good judgement when she attempted to make a U-turn in the middle of a two-lane road.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined during the investigation that a caregiver did not demonstrate competency. The caregiver knew there was rule in place by the YMCA to not allow children to use the monkey bars; however, the caregiver allowed multiple children to use the monkey bars without stopping them, and it led to an injury to a child later in the day.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement when failing to follow the operation's policy requiring an adult to accompany a child from outside to inside to use the bathroom.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During an investigation it was determined a caregiver did not use good judgement when not completing transition sheet as trained by operation.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined that  fifth grade school aged children were left in charge of the younger children, with no adult supervision. In addition, caregivers did not communicate with each other as to which children were granted permission to use the restroom. This resulted in caregivers being unaware of which children were out of the classroom area, which in turn resulted in children engaging in inappropriate behaviors in the restroom.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it was found that caregiver(s) failed to use good judgment by allowing the children to remain on equipment they were prohibited from using.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Upon leaving the operation it was observed that a caregiver allowed a school age child to be among a group of high school children who are not enrolled in the program.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation did not demonstrate appropriate competency in the attendance verification and child identification process when the wrong child was signed in.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregivers failed to demonstrate competency and good judgement when they did not administer first aid to an injured child.  Caregivers stated that first aid was not provided due to a lack of available supplies and indicated they were still gathering information during that time.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient information to support a caregiver failed to use good judgement when they yelled and use profane language in the presence of children.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Operation's staffs did not show good judgment when asking a 9 year old child to care for a special need child as she was a caregiver.
Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregivers did not show good judgment when they carried a child.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated for this investigation.  Poor judgement was used when referring to children as being annoying.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The director did not show good judgement by not informing all parents of children who were involved in an incident at the operation.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During an investigation operation was found deficient when a caregiver did not use good judgment when allowing a pipe cleaner to remain tightened around child's neck for an extended period of time resulting in red mark.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered through the course of the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not exercise good judgment by allowing a student to sit in their lap and engage in hugging in a manner that is inappropriate. The investigation also found that the caregiver was carrying children on his hip and holding them in his arms in a manner inconsistent with appropriate caregiving practices.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation has a child in care without the appropriate medication to treat the child if they come in to contact with listed allergy while present at the option or on field trips.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined a caregiver instructed one of the children to assist another child when asked for help during restroom used.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Two staff did not use good judgment when involving the children in prank wars. This resulted in a child being left in a classroom without proper supervision and a group being out of ratio.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregivers did not demonstrate good judgment when they sent children to the restroom independently and did not following policies in regard to propping open doors.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation,   a caregiver failed to exhibit good judgment by delaying the report of the use of inappropriate discipline and neglecting to report similar inappropriate conduct on at least two previous occasions.
Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver demonstrated inappropriate behavior while interacting with a child in care.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment and self-control during an interaction with a child.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The standard was evaluated during an investigation and was determined to be deficient. The caregiver did not use good judgment in their methods of redirecting a child's behavior. In an effort to manage the child's biting behavior, the caregiver pretended to bite the child as part of their interaction.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The former site director did not use good judgment by starting a group text message with three children at the operation while she was employed. During that time, the site director shared personal information and other adults' private information with the children.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered during the investigation and video footage  reviewed, it is determined that a caregiver and site director did not use good judgment by  allowing a child to expose himself with only a shirt on multiple times following a toileting  incident for about 20 minutes on and off.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During an investigation, there was sufficient evidence to support the allegation that caregivers were not using good judgment when they had the children have snack time outside when the temperature was 35-36 degrees with additional wind chill.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, this standard was found to be deficient.  The Site director showed poor judgment when they took on the responsibility of releasing children to their authorized persons when they were not familiar with the children who were in care.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence found to determine that a caregiver did not demonstrate competency and good judgment when she did not take off a child's jacket to see if the child's arm was injured.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: At time of inspection, a caregiver failed to demonstrate competency by not knowing where to get an ice pack for a child with a minor injury and walking away from the child.
Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation continues to allow multiple children to use the restroom at one time.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The caregiver didn't show good judgment when the child climbed onto the table and, unable to safely remove them, decided to leave the child there to continue playing on it.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not use good judgment when they allowed multiple children to use the restroom at once after they had been trained to not allow this.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregiver was observed on the playground sitting at a picnic table not supervising the playing children.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver used poor judgment  by using the microphone and PA system on the stage in the cafeteria and proceeded to consistently yell at the children for various reasons and situations.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information provided during the course of the investigation, one staff used poor judgement by telling a child she would be calling the police due to the child's behavior.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a caregiver used poor judgement when pushing a child and making them feel uncomfortable and scared.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff failed to demonstrate good judgement and self-control when they engaged in a verbal and physical altercation with non-staff, while children were in care.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on DFPS findings, good judgement was not used when a caregiver exposed the child by compelling and encouraging inappropriate behavior when entering a  storage closet with the child and turning off the lights.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Evidence gathered during the investigation shows a caregiver did not use good judgment or self-control when she cursed in front of children, flipped off a child, and played music for the children that contained inappropriate language.  This staff was fired.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A staff member used poor judgement when she showed photographs of an electric chair and legal injection photos to children after a conversation on bullying.     The violation has been corrected.  The staff member is no longer employed by the program.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Staff did not demonstrate good judgment when they allowed an 8 year old child to play with other YMCA children. The 8 year old is not enrolled at the YMCA. The 8 year old's parents were not in the gym area where the YMCA staff and children were.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on DFPS findings, good judgement was not used when a caregiver exposed the child by compelling and encouraging inappropriate behavior when entering a  storage closet with the child and turning off the lights.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information provided during a DPFS investigation there is sufficient evidence the caregiver did not demonstrate competency, good judgement and self-control when they threw two children to the ground.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The employee failed to confirm with the child's parent that transportation services was not required.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver did not use good judgment when they rewarded children for giving the caregiver the best back massage.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was found deficient.    The caregiver was aware of the incident but did not inform the site director and the parent when the child was picked up at the operation.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation did not demonstrate good judgement by allowing a child to play on active play equipment without reviewing the manufacturer's instructions.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. A caregiver did not use good judgment when they were playing with children in care by pushing them very high in swings constructed of hard plastic designed for physically impaired children, resulting in a child sustaining an injury that required medical attention.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the evidence obtained during a DFPS investigation, a staff member did not exercise good judgement when they signed a child in prior to verifying the child was present at the operation.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. A child was left in the bathroom during a transition when the caregiver did not properly account for all children in her care.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The permit holders did not exercise good judgment when children in care are allowed to remain outside in extreme weather conditions for an extended amount of time due to licensed space inside the facility being inaccessible to them during all hours of care.
Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A child under the age of 5 was injured on a playground that was rated for children ages 5 and up.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The caregiver did not use good judgement when he allowed two children to leave the operation without verifying the parent was in possession of the children.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The caregiver did not show good judgment when they allowed a child to cross the street to go to their parents car that was parked in the parking lot and not in the parent pick up lane.
